new.exam_name: ICG Navik GD (Indian Coast Guard Navik General Duty)
new.aliases: Coast Guard Navik GD; CGEPT Navik GD; ICG Sailor GD; Coast Guard Enrolled Personnel Test
new.last_date: 3rd week of October (21 Oct in 2026 cycle)
new.eligibility: Class 12 passed with Maths and Physics from a board recognised by COBSE. Age: born between 01 Nov 2005 and 01 May 2009 for the 01/27 and 02/27 batches; relaxation of 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST. Open to men and women. Must meet ICG medical and physical standards.
new.paper_pattern: Stage I is one computer based test of 100 objective questions, 1 mark each, in Hindi and English, 1 hour, no negative marking. Passing marks: 40 (UR/EWS/OBC), 35 (SC/ST). Section-wise syllabus is on the recruitment portal, not in the advertisement.
new.selection_process: Stage I: computer based test → Stage II: physical fitness test, assessment & adaptability test, document verification, recruitment medical → Stage III: document check & pre-enrolment medical at INS Chilka → Stage IV: verification of original documents with boards
new.remarks: Final merit is based on Stage I marks; Stage II is qualifying only. Male Navik GD vacancies are split across five zones with separate merit lists; female vacancies are all-India.

vacancies.note: CGEPT 01/2027 (130: 117 male, 13 female) + CGEPT 02/2027 (130: 117 male, 13 female), both notified 06 Oct 2026. Tentative.

new.notes: All figures from the official CGEPT 01/2027 & 02/2027 advertisement, hosted on ssc.gov.in; SSC handled applications this cycle. The joinindiancoastguard.cdac.in PDFs returned 403. No official or attributed applicant count was found. Exam dates are from the SSC notice dated 06 Nov 2026. A 1-hour test is stated; no minimum percentage in Class 12 is stated in the advertisement.

new.exam_name: ICG AC (Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant)
new.aliases: Coast Guard Assistant Commandant; CGCAT; Coast Guard Common Admission Test; ICG Officer GD; ICG Officer Technical
new.forms_out: June-July and January-February (two batches a year, as per notification)
new.last_date: As per notification (27 Jul 2025 for the 2027 batch)
new.eligibility: General Duty: a graduate degree, with Maths and Physics up to Class 12 (or a diploma with Maths and Physics). Technical: an engineering degree in specified mechanical or electrical/electronics branches (or AMIE), with Maths and Physics up to Class 12. Final-year students can apply. Age 21-25 years (for the 2027 batch, born 01 Jul 2001 to 30 Jun 2005); relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC where posts are reserved. Men only for this batch.
new.paper_pattern: CGCAT (Stage I) has 100 objective questions in English over 2 hours: English 25, Reasoning & Numerical Ability 25, General Science & Mathematical Aptitude 25, General Knowledge 25. Each correct answer gets 4 marks; 1 mark is deducted for each wrong answer.
new.selection_process: Stage I: CGCAT (online test) → Stage II: Preliminary Selection Board (cognitive test, picture perception & discussion) & document check → Stage III: Final Selection Board at Noida (psychological test, group tasks, interview) → Stage IV: medical exam at Base Hospital, New Delhi → Stage V: induction at INA Ezhimala
new.remarks: This is a Group A gazetted officer post, with starting basic pay of Rs. 56,100/- (Pay Level 10). The final all-India merit list combines Stage I and Stage III marks.
